with.questions.nx:
import "@nx/viewer"

/// The address of a picture.
export type ImageUrl = string
export type ChoiceLayout = list | grid | chips
export type Choice = { value:string label:string description?:string imageUrl?:ImageUrl color?:string }

export abstract component <Question id:string label:string help?:string required:boolean = true />
export component <SingleChoice extends Question layout:ChoiceLayout = list allowsOther:boolean = false
  content choices:Choice+ /> = { <div /> }

viewer ImageUrl = <ValueViewer format=image />
viewer ChoiceLayout =
  <UnionViewer>
    <CaseViewer of=list label="a list" />
    <CaseViewer of=chips label="chips" example="A B C" />
  </UnionViewer>
viewer Choice =
  <ElementViewer layout=row title=label subtitle=description badge=value>
    <PropertyViewer of=color format=color />
  </ElementViewer>
viewer Question =
  <ElementViewer title=label subtitle=help>
    <PropertyViewer of=required whenTrue="Required" whenFalse="Optional" />
    <PropertyViewer of=id label="Key" place=details />
  </ElementViewer>

formats.source:
import "@nx/viewer"

type Contact = { site:string email:string phone:string bio:string note:string other:string }

viewer Contact =
  <ElementViewer>
    <PropertyViewer of=site format=url />
    <PropertyViewer of=email format=email />
    <PropertyViewer of=phone format=phone />
    <PropertyViewer of=bio format=markdown />
    <PropertyViewer of=note format=text />
    <PropertyViewer of=other format=url />
  </ElementViewer>

let name = "Ada"
let ada = <Contact site="https://example.com" email="ada@example.com" phone="+1 (555) 010-0199" bio="Writes *notes*." note="plain" other={name} />
